## What's new in AniTenshi 1.0.19

- **Settings one tap away**: the ⋮ menu of the Library, Updates, Download queue and Browse screens now ends with a gold gear item that opens the matching page of the settings: Library settings, Update settings (on the automatic updates), Download settings and Browse settings. The Download queue menu is there even when the queue is empty. Back brings you to where you were.
- **New updates on the bell**: the number of new chapters or episodes shown on the round Anime and Manga buttons now also appears on the bell at the top of each library, where it is clear what it counts. It goes away when you open the updates, like the one on the button, and follows the same setting.
